confirmed_findings.statement: Binance's official FAQ identifies the public SAFU BTC wallet and says partial SAFU deployment is expected within 24 hours of its October 31 14:24 UTC update; the FAQ says part of SAFU is being used to acquire the remaining affected assets.
The Binance-designated SAFU BTC address is displayed by BitInfoCharts at 15,000.00147092 BTC, with last listed outgoing transaction April 18, 2024 and last listed incoming transaction August 9, 2026.

Binance says the Futures Insurance Fund was rebalanced and that the remaining fund stays above the required minimum; Binance states the fund is not user assets and exists to cover bankrupt-position deficits and reduce ADL.

SwoleCharts reports Binance aggregate futures insurance funds at approximately USD 2.46B as of 15:00 UTC, +0.14% 24h and +0.62% 7d; its Binance XRPUSDT pool is shared across ten symbols, while its Bybit XRPUSD pool is a separate isolated pool holding approximately 55.58M XRP.

ADGM's official register lists Nest Clearing and Custody Limited as active Recognised Clearing House 0070, previous name Binance (AD) Limited, trading name Binance, with custody and central securities depository activities.
Binance's official ADGM structure separates on-exchange activity at Nest Exchange, clearing/custody at Nest Clearing and Custody, and off-exchange/OTC activity at Nest Trading.

safu_reconciliation.interpretation: This is a timing and address-level reconciliation gap, not proof that Binance did not deploy SAFU elsewhere or off-chain. The official FAQ may refer to a future transfer or another permitted funding path. Monitor the named wallet through the full 24-hour window.

futures_insurance_fund.official_binance_claim: Remaining Futures Insurance Fund is above the required minimum; excess above the minimum was reallocated.

nest_exchange.role: Recognised Investment Exchange; on-exchange spot and derivatives

nest_trading.role: Broker-Dealer; off-exchange principal/agency, OTC and Convert

institutional_structure.regulatory_capital_note: Binance says a portion of SAFU funds serves ADGM regulatory capital reserves; freely deployable amount is not disclosed.

hypotheses.statement: The announced SAFU deployment had not yet been executed from the publicly identified BTC wallet by 16:45 UTC; the official 24-hour window remained open until November 1 14:24 UTC.
support: Official FAQ says deployment is expected over the next 24 hours and identifies the BTC address.
BitInfoCharts displays 15,000.00147092 BTC and no outgoing transaction after April 18, 2024.
disconfirming: The address may not represent every SAFU asset/account; deployment may occur through another address, OTC or an off-chain arrangement.
hypotheses.next_test: Recheck the exact address and all outgoing transactions after 2026-11-01T14:24Z; compare with the official updated balance link and any Binance transaction disclosure.

hypotheses.statement: A portion of Binance's Futures Insurance Fund may have been reallocated even though the third-party aggregate remained near USD 2.46B and rose over the observed 7-day window.
support: Binance explicitly says excess above the required minimum was reallocated.
SwoleCharts shows multiple pools and a large aggregate fund.
disconfirming: SwoleCharts aggregate was +0.14% 24h and +0.62% 7d; no visible aggregate drawdown.
Fees, prices and transfers among pools can offset the effect; no official pre/post amount was captured.
hypotheses.next_test: Compare Binance's official 00:00 UTC insurance-fund snapshots and pool-level balances before and after the reallocation; reconcile against public API history.

hypotheses.statement: The legal custodian and regulatory-capital role of Nest Clearing and Custody may constrain the portion of SAFU that can be deployed without breaching ADGM requirements.
support: ADGM register confirms Nest Clearing and Custody is an active Recognised Clearing House with custody and CSD activities.
Binance says a portion of SAFU serves ADGM regulatory capital reserves.
disconfirming: No public capital requirement amount, segregated balance or deployable excess was disclosed.
hypotheses.next_test: Review public FSRA filings, audited financial statements and subsequent Binance disclosures for reserve segregation and minimum capital requirements.

hypotheses.statement: Bybit's XRPUSD isolated insurance pool may provide a measurable XRP-specific derivatives backstop; Binance's XRPUSDT pool is shared across ten symbols and cannot be treated as XRP-only coverage.
support: SwoleCharts lists 55.58M XRP in Bybit XRPUSD isolated and 65.83M USDT in Binance XRPUSDT shared across ten symbols.
disconfirming: No synchronized contract OI, pool loss history or official methodology was reconciled.
hypotheses.next_test: Obtain Bybit XRPUSD OI and Binance XRPUSDT contract-level OI, then compute pool coverage with time-aligned values and source methodology.

feature_admission.reason: No normalized historical denominator, official pool-level series or independent balance reconciliation.

next_actions: Recheck the SAFU BTC address after the full 24-hour deployment window ending 2026-11-01 14:24 UTC.
Capture Binance's official Futures Insurance Fund balance page at the next 00:00 UTC refresh and compare with SwoleCharts.
Obtain full Binance post-incident PoR and asset-level XRP liabilities/reserves.
Reconcile Binance XRPUSDT shared-pool and Bybit XRPUSD isolated-pool coverage against contract-level OI.
Review public FSRA disclosures for Nest Clearing and Custody capital requirements and SAFU segregation.
